roles.functionStatement: Keep a regulated facility in documented compliance with its permits, rules and reporting obligations.

instruments.label: Signatory and certification requirements for permit reports
RCRA hazardous waste permits and state authorization

bands.indicativeBand: GS-5 to GS-7 (entry); GS-9 to GS-11 (journey)

majorDuties.duty: Manage a regulated facility's environmental compliance system and obligations calendar

tasks.statement: Develop a facility compliance checklist and procedures from its permits and applicable rules, assigning an owner and deadline to each obligation
Update the facility compliance calendar when a permit, rule or reporting requirement changes, notifying each obligation owner of the change
Prepare a periodic compliance report for the facility, checking reported values against source data before the responsible official certifies it
Investigate a permit exceedance at the facility, identifying the root cause and documenting corrective actions and the notice given to the agency
Coordinate a regulatory agency's inspection or audit of the facility, providing requested records and documenting each finding raised

majorDuties.duty: Manage regulated-entity disclosure and compliance across divergent regimes

tasks.statement: Prepare a mandatory disclosure report from controlled data collected across operations, tracing each reported figure to its source system

majorDuties.duty: Track regulatory change and translate it into operating guidance

tasks.statement: Screen automated regulatory-change alerts for a program each week, confirming which items affect its decisions and recording why the rest do not
Update program procedures and templates to a new governing version, recording which pending actions follow the old and new versions

majorDuties.duty: Manage field sample custody and field quality control

tasks.statement: Complete chain-of-custody records for every sample from collection to laboratory receipt, recording each transfer, seal and temperature check
Collect field duplicates, splits and blanks at the frequency the sampling plan specifies, labelling them so the laboratory cannot identify them

majorDuties.duty: Work safely on hazardous, industrial and energized field sites

tasks.statement: Follow a site health and safety plan at a contaminated or industrial site, observing zone boundaries, air-monitoring action levels and decontamination steps
Identify signs of potential hazardous materials at a field site, such as drums, stained soil, odours or unusual debris, before disturbing them

majorDuties.duty: Apply safety practices and stop-work authority across field, facility and incident settings

tasks.statement: Exercise stop-work authority when field, facility or incident conditions exceed the stated safety limits of the assignment
Deliver a pre-work safety briefing that covers site hazards, controls, communications and the stop-work procedure for the assigned work area

majorDuties.duty: Maintain independence and manage conflicts of interest across the regulator-regulated boundary

tasks.statement: Apply post-employment restrictions when moving between a regulator and a regulated party, obtaining written ethics advice before contact on covered matters
Disclose financial, employment or relationship interests that could affect an assignment before work begins, using the organization's conflict form

majorDuties.duty: Build and maintain a defensible administrative record

tasks.statement: Index documents into the administrative record with dates, authors and provenance labels, marking which content was produced with AI assistance

majorDuties.duty: Build organizational and jurisdictional greenhouse gas inventories for disclosure and reporting

tasks.statement: Compile a greenhouse gas inventory for an organization or jurisdiction, documenting boundaries, activity data, emission factors and methods for each source.

majorDuties.duty: Map the decision authority and procedural pathway for a proposed action

tasks.statement: Track the status of each authorization for a project against the pathway plan, notifying the project team when a delay moves the critical path

majorDuties.duty: Record provenance and AI involvement in work products

tasks.statement: Record the source, date, version, method and any AI tool used for a dataset or analysis, using the organization's provenance template.

bands.pctTimeNotice: % time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.

knowledgeStatements: Stop-work authority lets any worker halt a task they judge unsafe; the task resumes only after the hazard is assessed and the plan revised, and the person who stopped it is not penalized.
A no-blame incident review separates system and condition causes from individual error and sanctions only reckless or wilful acts, so that people keep reporting near misses.
